rule: Only explicitly listed live routing branches or issue-bound active carriers may route current authority. Every other branch is historical evidence, regardless of legacy prefix.

active_carriers.note: Issue-bound frozen fallback carrier; cannot promote, merge, validate, or route authority by existence alone.

migration_semantics: Rename/move stale and superseded refs under historical/ when branch-ref deletion/rename capability is available. Do not create duplicate historical aliases while leaving legacy refs in place, because that increases noise.
